test_title: PYST 74: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

Rahul won the extempore competition. He is lucky to be blessed with the __gift of the gab__.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"gift of the gab"** means a talent for speaking fluently and persuasively. (अच्छी और प्रभावशाली बातचीत करने की प्रतिभा) • **Example: **Politicians often have the gift of the gab, which helps them to engage with the public effectively. • **"Gift of the gab"** refers to the ability to speak easily, confidently, and in a way that makes people want to listen to you. (अच्छी और प्रभावशाली बातचीत करने की क्षमता) • **Example: **She has the gift of the gab, making her an excellent salesperson. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: An honest person** (ईमानदार व्यक्ति): Someone who is truthful and sincere. • **Example:** She is known to be an honest person who never lies. • **Option 2: A big surprise** (बड़ा आश्चर्य): Something unexpected and astonishing. • **Example: **The news of his promotion came as a big surprise to everyone. • **Option 3: A lucky person** (भाग्यशाली व्यक्ति): Someone who frequently experiences good fortune. • **Example:** He is such a lucky person; he always wins the lottery. 32:Tc5a, The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
